description: This file defines the 'Meal' result class for the Coocook schema, including its columns, relationships, and methods for managing meal data within the application.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Meal
classes.description: Represents a meal entity in the database with properties, relationships, and methods for meal management.

methods.name: deletable
methods.description: Determines if the meal can be deleted, i.e., it has no associated dishes or prepared dishes.

methods.name: delete_dishes
methods.description: Deletes all dishes associated with the meal, except for prepared dishes.

methods.name: for_meals_dishes_editor
methods.description: Prepares a hashref suitable for editing dishes related to the meal, including related dishes and their properties.
